Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon is suspended, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of your opponent's turn.
